examples: Make a key named crate sync on the mini, copy it into 1Password, and run the crate cli with --token-op pointing at that item: export and restore run headless with no sign in.
Revoke a key from the list behind a warning: the script using it gets 401 on its next request.
A leaked key cannot make another key, revoke yours, mint an mcp token or sign in.
how_to: Open settings, remote and security, api keys.
Type a name for the script and press new key. Copy the key at once into 1Password; it is never shown again.
Send it as Authorization: Bearer cak_... from the script, or pass --token-op op://<vault>/<item>/credential to the crate cli.
Press revoke on a key, then revoke key in the warning, when the script is retired.
media_exempt: settings panel whose proof is its vitest and the route tests; a screenshot is captured at the next version bump
name: API keys for scripts
summary: long-lived api keys for your own scripts: made and revoked in settings, stored only as a hash, valid on every api route except key management, sign in and mcp token minting.
where: Settings, remote and security, api keys.
